text:
Sofia P.: Heads-up — we need legal sign-off + recording slot for the CarbonFlow case spotlight. Draft Qs + proposed quote live here: https://drive.redwood/case-carbonflow/questions-v2.md. Can we lock a 30m recording next Tue/Wed morning PST? Elaine, can you fast-track the redlines? :pray:

Maria L.: I skimmed the quote. small tweak — change 'cut inference cost by 60%' to 'reduced per-token cost by ~60% on peak workloads'. less absolute. otherwise good.

Aj Chen: Also, for webinar lead routing: are we sending CarbonFlow registrants to the product AE queue or the enterprise SDR pool? We should set a Pardot tag either way.

Elaine K.: I can review today. One immediate legal concern: the phrase about 'real-time SLAs' might be construed as a guarantee. Also need backup for the cost number (link to internal benchmark or customer consent). If you can paste the source for the 60% claim I can clear the language.

Sofia P.: Thanks Elaine — source is the internal perf deck: https://drive.redwood/perf/carbonflow-benchmark-2025.pdf. Maria's rewording works for us. Proposed final quote: "With Redwood, we reduced per-token cost by ~60% on peak workloads while maintaining our latency SLOs."

Jamal R.: +1 to Maria's phrasing. For routing: send webinar registrants to the product AE queue for now, capture intent tags and send hot leads to SDRs. I'll update the routing doc after we finalize the publish copy.

marketing-bot: Event created — "CarbonFlow customer spotlight recording" 2025-11-26 10:00 PST (calendar invite sent to Sofia P., Maria L., Jamal R., CarbonFlow participants).

Maria L.: Approved with tweak. Final copy saved: https://drive.redwood/marketing/CarbonFlow-final-quote.md.

Elaine K.: Legal review complete. Minor redline accepted; legal ok to publish. Please include the benchmark link in the case assets and add this note: "Benchmark performed by CarbonFlow and Redwood on representative workloads; results may vary."

Sofia P.: Amazing — thanks everyone. I'll lock the recording time, update the landing page copy with the approved quote and legal note, and coordinate with Aj/Jamal on lead tagging. Will post a final publishing checklist here once done. :rocket:
